固定原784期、7串1、每期1024元上限、2元单位、10万元本金、一次0.65。
本轮是看过回撤后提出的历史研究，所有新增规则在全部784期执行；700期并非启停条件。
两个事后诊断段分别为671–685期和716–771期，另单列700–784期全部表现。

复用上一报告封存的同版本逐期预测和LONG现金票。不是重新训练，也不把后期模型用于早期。
原模型来自共享时序模块，每个预测绑定自己的cutoff、原始来源、代码、历史准入和权重账本。
标签可用时间是最后比赛截止时间＋48小时代理，原概率包也仅供暴露历史研究，不构成实时交易验收。
本轮新分配单独绑定版本/参数/代码并封存，随后才打开目标期结算。

四个固定减仓规则均以LONG现金票为起点，释放资金保留现金：

- CELL_CAP：单个格子最多占起始保留票数25%，超出部分从低概率票削减。
- LOWP_CAP：概率低于0.2%的票合计最多占10%。
- RECENT_LOW：低于0.2%的票，仅在同格历史支持充足且混合命中实现低于0.8时减半。
- LONG_RETURN：历史支持充足且累计回款/投入低于1时，该格剩余票减半。

每个规则另配同投入、同票数的PROB对照：只按概率从低到高减去相同数量的票。
没有新增候选、加倍、赛果替换、种子搜索或概率模型更新。

for(k in c('plans-receipt.json')) {

 objects[[k]]<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)

```{r}
plans<-list();modes<-c('CELL_CAP','LOWP_CAP','RECENT_LOW','LONG_RETURN')
xs<-split(x,x$issue);fs<-split(f,f$issue)
for(id in order) {
 t<-if(id %in% names(xs))xs[[id]] else x[FALSE,]
 s<-if(id %in% names(fs))fs[[id]] else f[FALSE,]
 cut<-cuts[[id]]
 stopifnot(all(t$cutoff_identity==cut$cutoff_identity))
 attr(s,'input_receipt')<-list(cutoff=cut,hash=digest::digest(s,algo='sha256'))
 for(mode in modes) {
  a<-joint_tail_risk(t,s,cut,params$parent_sha256,mode,.25,.002,.1,.8,1,2,1024)
  # Independent vector/rank replay, without calling the allocation function.
  replay<-t |> left_join(s |> select(cell,hit_ratio,long_return_ratio,long_hit_signal,supported),by='cell',relationship='many-to-one') |>
   filter(base_copies==1L) |> arrange(desc(prob),ticket_id)
  nbase<-nrow(replay)
  if(mode=='LOWP_CAP') {
   low<-replay |> filter(prob<.002) |> slice_head(n=floor(nbase*.1))
   selected<-replay$ticket_id[replay$prob>=.002 | replay$ticket_id %in% low$ticket_id]
  } else if(mode=='CELL_CAP') {
   selected<-(replay |> group_by(cell) |> filter(row_number()<=floor(nbase*.25)) |> ungroup())$ticket_id
  } else {
   replay<-replay |> mutate(fire=!is.na(long_hit_signal) & long_hit_signal!='UNKNOWN' &
     if(mode=='LONG_RETURN')is.finite(long_return_ratio) & long_return_ratio<1 else
       !is.na(supported) & supported & is.finite(hit_ratio) & hit_ratio<.8 & prob<.002) |>
     group_by(cell,fire) |> mutate(keep=!fire | row_number()<=ceiling(n()/2)) |> ungroup()
   selected<-replay$ticket_id[replay$keep]
  }
  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(t$ticket_id %in% selected),a$copies))
  # Current/future settlement is not supplied to selection; changing attached
  # unused diagnostic fields cannot alter the selected ticket IDs.
  mutated<-t;mutated$actual_gross<-seq_len(nrow(t))*1e9
  stopifnot(identical(a,joint_tail_risk(mutated,s,cut,params$parent_sha256,mode,.25,.002,.1,.8,1,2,1024)))
  plans[[paste(id,mode)]]<-a |> mutate(issue=id,policy=mode,cutoff_identity=cut$cutoff_identity)
  chosen<-t |> filter(base_copies==1) |> arrange(desc(prob),ticket_id) |> slice_head(n=sum(a$copies))
  matched<-a;matched$copies<-as.integer(matched$ticket_id %in% chosen$ticket_id)
  stopifnot(sum(matched$copies)==sum(a$copies))
  plans[[paste(id,mode,'PROB')]]<-matched |> mutate(issue=id,policy=paste0(mode,'_PROB'),cutoff_identity=cut$cutoff_identity)
 }
 if(match(id,order)%%100==0)message('Frozen and replayed ',match(id,order),' issues')
}
p<-bind_rows(plans);out<-params$output;dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
write_csv(p,file.path(out,'frozen-plans.csv'))
stopifnot(identical(code,setNames(as.list(vapply(file.path(params$project_root,code_files),digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),code_files)))
jsonlite::write_json(list(historical_admission=FALSE,imported_model_receipt=params$parent_sha256,
 sources=list(original_freeze=objects[['plans-receipt.json']]$source_hashes$frozen,
 original_tickets=fr$receipt$plan_hashes,forecasts=parent$files[['forecasts.csv']],
 base_plans=parent$files[['frozen-plans.csv']],contexts=parent$files[['contexts.json']],metadata=params$metadata_sha256),
 cutoffs=cuts,imported_model_implementation=closures,new_import_implementation=import_closure,code=code,
 parameters=list(cell_fraction=.25,low_probability=.002,low_fraction=.1,recent_bad_ratio=.8,return_floor=1,
 unit_cny=2,budget_cny=1024,initial_capital_cny=100000),
 independent_replays=length(order)*length(modes),plans_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(out,'frozen-plans.csv'),algo='sha256')),
 file.path(out,'plans-receipt.json'),pretty=TRUE,auto_unbox=TRUE,digits=NA)
```

以下才打开目标结算。所有方案沿用相同原组、相同模型版本；下列窗口为事后诊断，不触发规则。

```{r}
g<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$depth_report,'groups.csv'),depth$outputs[['groups.csv']],cols(issue='c')) |>
 filter(arm=='JOINT') |> select(issue,sleeve_id,actual_rank,actual_gross_cny)
z<-x |> left_join(g,by=c('issue','sleeve_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(hit=prob_rank==actual_rank,gross=if_else(hit,actual_gross_cny,0))
stopifnot(!anyNA(z$hit))
labels<-z |> select(issue,ticket_id,hit,gross)
r<-p |> left_join(labels,by=c('issue','ticket_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 group_by(issue,policy) |> summarise(stake=sum(2*copies),gross=sum(gross*copies),hits=sum(hit*copies),.groups='drop')
r<-expand_grid(issue=order,policy=c(modes,paste0(modes,'_PROB'))) |> left_join(r,by=c('issue','policy')) |>
 mutate(across(c(stake,gross,hits),~replace_na(.x,0)))
old<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$parent,'rows.csv'),parent$files[['rows.csv']],cols(issue='c')) |>
 filter(policy %in% c('P0_OPEN','long_cash_only'))
rebuilt<-z |> group_by(issue) |> summarise(stake=sum(2*base_copies),gross=sum(gross*base_copies),hits=sum(hit*base_copies),.groups='drop') |>
 left_join(old |> filter(policy=='long_cash_only'),by='issue',suffix=c('_new','_old'),relationship='one-to-one')
stopifnot(all(abs(rebuilt$gross_new-rebuilt$gross_old)<1e-6),all(rebuilt$stake_new==rebuilt$stake_old),all(rebuilt$hits_new==rebuilt$hits_old))
rows<-bind_rows(old |> select(issue,policy,stake,gross,hits),r) |> mutate(net=gross-stake,
 budget_cny=1024,cash_cny=1024-stake,status=if_else(stake>0,'COMPLETE','NO_BET'),model='frozen-market') |>
 left_join(map,by='issue',relationship='many-to-one')
curves<-strategy_equity_curves(rows |> select(-period),order,100000)
stopifnot(!any(curves$stopped))
windows<-tribble(~window,~start,~end,'ALL',1L,784L,'PRE700',1L,699L,'TAIL700',700L,784L,
 'CLIFF671',671L,685L,'TAIL_DROP716',716L,771L)
summary<-joint_tail_windows(rows,windows)
bridge<-p |> left_join(z |> select(issue,ticket_id,base_copies,gross),by=c('issue','ticket_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 filter(base_copies==1 & copies==0) |> left_join(map,by='issue',relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(scope=if_else(period>=700,'TAIL700','PRE700')) |> group_by(policy,scope) |>
 summarise(removed_stake=2*n(),removed_gross=sum(gross),removed_net=removed_gross-removed_stake,.groups='drop')
cell_rows<-z |> left_join(map,by='issue') |> left_join(f |> select(issue,cell,long_hit_ratio,long_return_ratio,long_hit_signal,hit_signal),
 by=c('issue','cell'),relationship='many-to-one')
cell_tables<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(windows)))cell_tables[[windows$window[i]]]<-cell_rows |>
 filter(period>=windows$start[i],period<=windows$end[i]) |> group_by(cell) |>
 summarise(issues=n_distinct(issue),stake=2*n(),expected=sum(prob),hits=sum(hit),gross=sum(gross),
 prior_hit=mean(long_hit_ratio,na.rm=TRUE),prior_return=mean(long_return_ratio,na.rm=TRUE),
 bad_share=mean(long_hit_signal=='BAD',na.rm=TRUE),.groups='drop') |>
 mutate(window=windows$window[i],net=gross-stake,hit_ratio=hits/expected)
cells<-bind_rows(cell_tables)
correlation<-rows |> select(issue,policy,net) |> pivot_wider(names_from=policy,values_from=net) |>
 select(-issue) |> cor()
for(n in c('rows','curves','summary','bridge','cells'))write_csv(get(n),file.path(out,paste0(n,'.csv')))
write_csv(as_tibble(correlation,rownames='policy'),file.path(out,'correlations.csv'))
knitr::kable(summary,digits=3)
knitr::kable(bridge,digits=2)
knitr::kable(cells |> filter(window=='TAIL_DROP716') |> arrange(net),digits=3)
```

回撤改善必须同时看全期收益代价、700期前表现、期命中、实际投入以及同票数PROB对照。
减少投注不能增加原本未中的期数；这是资金风险覆盖实验，不是新增赛果覆盖。
相关系数按逐期净收益计算，不用累计曲线替代。没有对多个门槛挑选最优，也不宣称这些暴露历史结果可泛化。

本轮结论：LOWP_CAP把700期后的局部最大回撤从9327元降至7600元，但全期净收益从61422元降至42864元，全期最大回撤也没有改善。它与同票数的概率优先对照完全相同，因此这里证明的是少买低概率票可以缓冲局部损失，不是成功预测了退化。

CELL_CAP的同投入概率对照在700期后更好，说明单纯分散格子并非优选；LONG_RETURN在后段还会误删盈利票。当前证据不足以替换累计筛弱留现金方案。671–685期原方案15期只中1期，累计筛弱方案0期命中，新增规则仅通过少投入降低亏损，尚未补回命中覆盖。

原预测包作为已封存的历史研究证据导入；其context receipt未保存原始完整implementation closure，不能据此声称满足新版前瞻学习验收。metadata由独立提取步骤白名单保留cutoff和版本元数据，不带历史残差；提取脚本和输入哈希随报告留档。新分配的实现闭包及冻结票据另外绑定。
